title: A practical Open Graph checklist
description: Eight things to check before you share a link, so the preview looks right on Telegram, X, Facebook and LinkedIn.

blocks.text: Most broken previews come from the same few mistakes. Run through this list before you post a link anywhere.

items: **Absolute URLs.** `og:image` and `og:url` must start with `https://`. Relative paths are ignored.
**Image size.** Use 1200×630 PNG or JPEG. SVG and WebP aren't safe everywhere.
**Image weight.** Keep it under about 5 MB; smaller loads faster in chats.
**Title length.** Aim for 40–60 characters. Telegram wraps, X truncates.
**Description length.** 110–160 characters reads well on every platform.
**Cache-busting.** Platforms cache previews; plan how to refresh them.

blocks.title: Tip
blocks.text: This blog's Share lab checks all of these automatically for each post.

Telegram shows a large image only when it's wide enough; small or square images become a thumbnail on the right. X needs `twitter:card` to pick the large layout. LinkedIn caches aggressively and has its own Post Inspector to refresh.
